query:
UPDATE letterings SET
                            detected_text = COALESCE($1, detected_text),
                            ml_style = $2,
                            ml_color_palette = COALESCE($3, ml_color_palette),
                            cultural_context = COALESCE($4, cultural_context),
                            status = 'APPROVED',
                            updated_at = NOW()
                        WHERE id = $5
